subject: general
question: Indian food is rich in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Flavor.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To complete the blank in the given sentence, refer to the following line from the passage:
 
 
• Line 1 of paragraph 3:** Indian food is rich in flavor**. However, spices do more than flavor a dish;
 
 
 
• "Flavor" means the taste of food. (स्वाद)
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that the correct word to fill in the blank is "flavor."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1: Chilly - While Indian food can be spicy, it is not always the dominant flavor.(मिर्च)
 
• Option 3: Desi ghee - Desi ghee (clarified butter) is a common ingredient in Indian cooking, but it is not the main flavor.
 
• Option 4: Sesame oil - Sesame oil is used in some Indian dishes, but it is not a defining characteristic of Indian cuisine.
